summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.3W.1R.2B is a contract-only freeze phase that closes finding N2 (human-confirmation provenance was caller-manufacturable) by freezing RIHAC-001 v1.0->v1.1 (additive tightening: SS3/SS12/SS16 now require HumanPrincipalRegistry lookup plus authentication-proof verification as part of provenance evidence), RIASC-001 v1.0->v2.0 (MAJOR: provenance.approver_id/identity_evidence_kind retired, replaced by principal_id/authentication_mechanism_id/credential_id/authentication_proof_ref -- a required-field meaning redefinition under RIASC-001's own versioning rule), and a new companion contract HPAC-001 v1.0 (Human Principal Authentication Contract: deployment-scoped HumanPrincipalRegistry kept structurally and namespace-separate from HATP's own registry.json via Option B reuse -- pattern and low-level FIDO2 primitives shared, registry/principal-ID-space/challenge-domain not; HumanAuthenticator mechanism abstraction with no implementation; HumanAuthenticationProof shape; a ten-step fail-closed verification sequence producing a trusted-construction-only AuthenticatedHumanPrincipal). Primary v1 mechanism: hardware-backed FIDO2 (hpac.fido2.presence_gated.v1), user-presence (UP) required, user-verification (UV) deployment-configurable. Re-confirmed by full re-read (RIHAC-001 v1.0, RIASC-001 v1.0, PBRD-001 v1.1, RDGO-001 v2.0, RPAC-001 v1.0, HPSE-001 v1.1, the 3W.1R.2A architecture document, and src/pcae/core/runtime_authority.py) that PBRD-001, RDGO-001, and RPAC-001 require no changes. No src/pcae file was modified. No test file was modified. No hardware was touched. B1/B7/N1 were not repaired. Runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable; v0.4.3 unchanged.
